svg.aria-label: Forced embeds: the app wants its records with the subscriber joined in. A MongoDB view can join them but is read only, so every record embeds a copy of the subscriber's contact info. Some copies are history and should stay frozen: where an order shipped. Others must be current: a contact change has to be recopied everywhere, and a recall notice to everyone who received an item in the last 90 days needs today's contact info, not the copy. On Oracle a duality view joins the current subscriber row at read time and takes writes: snapshot what is history, reference what is current
